WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT st.s_store_id,
           SUM(u.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(u.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(u.return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(u.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
               SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_price,
               SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
        GROUP BY ss_store_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               SUM(sr_return_amt) AS return_amt,
               SUM(sr_net_loss) AS net_loss
        FROM store_returns
        WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
        GROUP BY sr_store_sk
    ) u
    JOIN store st ON u.store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY st.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(u.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(u.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(u.return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(u.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_price,
               SUM(cs_net_profit) AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_sales
        WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
        GROUP BY cs_catalog_page_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               SUM(cr_return_amount) AS return_amt,
               SUM(cr_net_loss) AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_returns
        WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
        GROUP BY cr_catalog_page_sk
    ) u
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON u.page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT ws.web_site_id,
           SUM(u.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(u.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(u.return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(u.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_price,
               SUM(ws_net_profit) AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM web_sales
        WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
        GROUP BY ws_web_site_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT w.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amt,
               SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS net_loss
        FROM (
            SELECT wr_item_sk, wr_order_number, wr_return_amt, wr_net_loss
            FROM web_returns
            WHERE wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
        ) wr
        JOIN web_sales w ON wr.wr_item_sk = w.ws_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = w.ws_order_number
        GROUP BY w.ws_web_site_sk
    ) u
    JOIN web_site ws ON u.wsr_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_id
),
details AS (
    SELECT channel,
           id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit) AS profit
    FROM (
        SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
               'store' || s_store_id AS id,
               sales,
               returns,
               (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
        FROM ssr
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
               'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
               sales,
               returns,
               (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
        FROM csr
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
               'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
               sales,
               returns,
               (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
        FROM wsr
    ) raw_details
    GROUP BY channel, id
),
subtotals AS (
    SELECT channel,
           NULL::text AS id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit) AS profit
    FROM details
    GROUP BY channel
),
grand AS (
    SELECT NULL::text AS channel,
           NULL::text AS id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           SUM(profit) AS profit
    FROM details
)
SELECT channel, id, sales AS sales, returns AS returns, profit AS profit
FROM details
UNION ALL
SELECT channel, id, sales AS sales, returns AS returns, profit AS profit
FROM subtotals
UNION ALL
SELECT channel, id, sales AS sales, returns AS returns, profit AS profit
FROM grand
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100

2. LEFT-JOIN-TO-INNER-JOIN CONVERSION — TARGET: `web_returns LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number)` in `wsr` — TRANSFORMATION: because the later `wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk` predicate rejects the null `ws_web_site_sk` rows produced by unmatched returns, rewrite this as an inner join; this discards unmatched web returns before aggregation and lets the planner use a PK probe from the date-filtered `web_returns` into `web_sales`.

3. COVERING INDEX FOR WEB-RETURN SITE LOOKUP — TARGET: `web_sales` accessed via `(ws_order_number, ws_item_sk)` in the `wsr` returns branch — TRANSFORMATION: create a covering index on `web_sales(ws_order_number, ws_item_sk) INCLUDE (ws_web_site_sk)` so the inner-join site lookup is an index-only probe and never fetches the wide `web_sales` heap row.

4. MANUAL ROLLUP AFTER PRE-AGGREGATION — TARGET: the outer `GROUP BY rollup(channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100` over the union of `ssr`/`csr`/`wsr` — TRANSFORMATION: once each CTE has been reduced to one aggregate row per channel id, compute the per-channel/id rows and append the channel subtotals and grand total through small explicit aggregate passes over those three already-small results, replacing the implicit multi-level rollup sort and letting the final order/limit work on a result of only hundreds of rows.
